ana: Heads up — I’m seeing a spike of ~120 accounts stuck in 'Onboarding - Waiting for Customer' in the last 24h. Looks correlated with the new webhook that writes last_activity — many rows are null. Can we temporarily adjust the playbook to not escalate on null last_activity? :eyes:

mira: Is this the healthscore recalibration that flips to 'stalled' after 72h? Are they scoring as At-Risk or just stuck? I can take a look at the rule.

ana: Stuck/stalled — they get the 'escalate to AE' workflow. Because last_activity is null it's triggering immediately. We should only escalate after 48h of no activity, and ignore nulls for 24h while webhook rollup is fixed.

rex: I can add a temporary filter in the playbook AND run a quick dedupe. Proposed condition:

```sql
-- playbook filter (psuedo-sql)
WHERE last_activity IS NOT NULL
  AND now() - last_activity > interval '48 hours'
  AND owner IS NOT NULL
```

I'll stage that change and run a dry-run.

chris: Please avoid firing owner emails for escalations during the dry-run window — owners will get noisy pings. Can we convert to digest notifications instead for the next 12h?

mira: Good call. I'll push patch to staging to enable digest and the new filter. @rex can you queue the dedupe script? I'll run a backfill sanity check (count delta) before promoting.

rex: queued. I'll run dedupe on contacts and return counts in ~90m. If dedupe delta < 0.5% we promote the patch.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled by mira — playbook patch v2026.3.21-1 to staging at 2026-03-21T14:05Z. Dry-run mode enabled (no owner emails).

ana: Thanks everyone. Please post the post-dry-run counts here. I'll hold escalation messages until we confirm. :thumbsup:
